title: FraudAlert
description: Value of topic pix.fraud-alerts.v1. Emitted by the antifraud service when a rule fires. Unknown properties are allowed for forward compatibility.

alert_id.description: Deterministic id: '<rule>:<triggered_by_event_id>'. Reprocessing the same event yields the same alert_id.

merchant_id.description: Restaurant identifier. Also the Kafka record key.

payment_id.description: Payment of the event that triggered the alert.

occurred_at.description: occurred_at of the triggering event, ISO-8601 in UTC.

details.description: Rule-specific numbers that explain why the alert fired.
